market_summary: During the New York session, markets show strong directional extensions: US100 pushed through upper ATR bands into Call Wall #1 resistance in a positive dampening gamma regime, prompting mean-reversion risk. GBPUSD and BTCUSD remain structurally bearish well below session VWAPs following severe downside impulses, but are currently consolidating or bouncing off session lows, leaving all three symbols in wait-and-see postures without clean risk/reward entries.

signals.rationale: VP context shows price consolidating near POC/VAH/VAL (1.32422) after a strong selloff. CVD is NEUTRAL (0.00) with zero slope. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well below VWAP (1.32639) and EMA50 (1.32614), trading right along the lower ATR band (1.32351). No RVOL > 2.0 spikes on this consolidation leg. Price swept Session Low 1.32235 and is currently pausing mid-bounce without clear volume confirmation or strong reversal delta. GEX is null. Stand aside until clear continuation or mean-reversion setup forms.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below downward sloping VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is above VAH (28207.98) and far above POC (28115.53). CVD is NEUTRAL (+3.12) with positive slope (+5.03). Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price holds well above VWAP (28140.99) and EMA50 (28163.46) but has pierced outside the upper ATR band (28416.85). RVOL last printed 1.1 with earlier breakout spikes (US100 tick volume caveat considered). Crucially, GEX regime is POSITIVE_DAMPENING (above Gamma Flip 28209.54), where dealers dampen momentum; price has spiked directly into and is stalling right above Call Wall #1 (28427.98) and near Session High (28528.49). With dampening gamma and extended ATR stretch, buying into dealer resistance is unfavorable while shorting lacks confirmation.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish sharp expansion above VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection at Session High 28528.49 and Call Wall #1

signals.rationale: Price is trading well below VAL (72575.29) and POC (73501.60). CVD is BEARISH (-0.08) with slight positive short-term slope (+0.02) reflecting counter-trend bounce attempts. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is structurally bearish below downward trending VWAP (72958.24) and EMA50 (72769.74). Following an RVOL spike down to Session Low 71141.0, price has bounced back above the lower ATR band (71392.38) and is testing EMA20 baseline (72141.15). GEX is null. While the broader trend is down, selling immediately into a post-climax bounce without a clean lower-high rejection against resistance is premature.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish heavily extended below VWAP and EMA50
